computation_spec.note: Aggregate quarterly P&L data across all test quarters for each contract. The ratio must fall within the effectiveness bounds for the hedge to qualify.

dedesignation_treatment.description: When a hedge fails the effectiveness test, the entire hedge relationship for that contract is dedesignated for the corresponding fiscal year. All revenue for that country-year pair is translated at the spot rate only. No hedge gain or loss is recognized for the dedesignated position.
dedesignation_treatment.accounting_reclassification: Fair value through profit or loss

parameters.hedge_gain_loss: For effective hedges: net_after_ecl * hedge_ratio * (forward_rate - spot_rate). Accumulated across all country-tier-month combinations where the hedge is effective.
parameters.note: Hedge gain/loss only recognized for the hedged portion of revenue where the hedge passes the effectiveness test

1.note: Monthly subscription revenue — single performance obligation satisfied over time. No variable consideration constraint applies to the base forecast.

ias21.title: The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates
ias21.note: Functional currency approach. Translation to USD presentation currency uses effective blended rate for hedged currencies (where hedge is effective), spot rate only for dedesignated hedges and USD-denominated revenue.

ias36.title: Impairment of Assets
ias36.note: Not applicable to subscription trade receivables — impairment is handled under IFRS 9 Section 5.5 ECL model. IAS 36 applies only to non-financial assets.

discount_curve.description: Bootstrap zero-coupon yield curve from par bond rates using iterative method. For each tenor n, solve for zero rate z_n from: 100 = SUM(C/(1+z_k)^k, k=1..n-1) + (100+C)/(1+z_n)^n, where C = par_rate * 100. The 1-year zero rate equals the 1-year par rate directly.
discount_curve.discount_factor_application: For forecast month m (1-indexed), discount factor = 1/(1+z_y)^(m/12), where y = CEIL(m/12) selects the zero rate tenor (capped at 5).
discount_curve.output_metric: npv_cumulative_revenue = SUM(monthly_net_revenue[m] * discount_factor[m]) over all 60 months
discount_curve.note_on_superseded: The flat_discount_rates table in the database contains superseded CFO estimates. These must NOT be used — the bootstrapped zero-coupon curve is the approved methodology.

ecl_policy.scenario_overlay: Apply forward-looking scenario weights from IFRS 9 Section 5.5.15 current_v2024 parameters
